name: fieldseal-build-binaries
description: Release build tooling ONLY. Not part of the shipped zero-dependency product. Produces statically bundled offline verify binaries via @yao-pkg/pkg.
comment: Exact pins only. See BUILD-DEPENDENCIES.md for integrity hashes and the offline-build procedure. A package-lock.json cannot be shipped: delivery gates S-06 and the read-only scanner reject any lockfile in the repository, because the product itself must stay zero-dependency.
